title: Slide Statements

solutions.title: Bake-quantity math, gathered next to the order it starts from
solutions.tradeoff: The shelf-tag lines and the bake-quantity lines are now two visible blocks instead of one braided sequence, so a reader who liked seeing 'everything about this item' in strict top-to-bottom order has to accept two paragraphs instead of one.

reviewFocus: Is standingUnits still separated from bufferUnits by any statement that does not read or write it? If so the slide is incomplete, not just imperfect.
Does bakeUnitsFor read or write shelfTag, displayName, or aisleCode anywhere - directly or through a shared parameter? If it doesn't, the slide was safe by the same test a reviewer should apply.
Was ovenBatchesUsed's running total replaced with a query over the lines, or does src/'s accumulator survive into the solution for no reason?
Does the walkthrough's before/after pair actually match the diff, or does it show a tidier version of the move than what the commits record?

Would you have sunk bakeUnitsFor into its own file instead of leaving it beside buildDailyBakePlan? Is there a real cost to either choice here, or is it a coin toss this drill shouldn't pretend is a decision?
